subject: cult-info-fo
title: CULT.INFO.F.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 30 (SD(SY)-8). The chart has no arrow, so the first code of the title is the subject: CULT-INFO-FO (the title writes CULT-INFO-F), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: DIFF, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From DIFF: INFO-INTR (information interpretation) and PRI-INFO (principle information); a line from DIFF's line ends at a dot with no label, and INFO-INTR branches from that line. From MTA-RT-SIGN: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). ACT (activism), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", is on a dashed line from PROJ-DY.
